verdict.rationale: Serving multiple LoRA adapters on a base model is a fair question for an on-device inference SDK and runtime like RunAnywhere, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions LoRA adapters, adapter loading or hot-swapping, or multi-adapter serving. The docs cover model downloads, streaming, tool calling, and NPU acceleration, none of which is this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can efficiently serve multiple LoRA adapters on top of a base model
